entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Babloo Kumar S/O Dauli Ram
Opposite Party :- State Of Up Thro Principal Secretary Home Gov Of Up Lucknow
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajesh Pratap Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Shiv Mangal Pandey
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1.
List revised.
No one appears on behalf of the applicants to press this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. Sri Ajay Singh, learned A.G.A-I for the State is present.

2. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants-Babloo Kumar, Dinesh and Mamta with the prayer to allow this application and to quash the entire proceeding of Criminal Case No. 4239 of 2023 and cognizance order dated 15.02.2023, as well as,
charge-sheet dated 23.09.2021 in Case Crime No. 184 of 2021 under Section 498A, 452, 354B, 323,
504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Soron, District Kasganj and further to stay the further proceedings of aforesaid case.
Babloo Kumar S/O Dauli Ram vs State Of Up Thro Principal Secretary ... on 5 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45885511/
1
3. Even previously on 10.02.2025, there was no representation on behalf of the applicants and following order was passed by this Court:-
"1. List revised.
No one appears on behalf of the applicant to press this application U/S 482 Cr.P.C. Sri Ram Prakash Shukla, learned counsel for the State is present.
Sri Shiv Mangal Pandey, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 is also not present even when the matter has been taken up in the revised list.

2. Since there is no representation on behalf of the applicant, in the interest of justice,
as a last opportunity, the matter is adjourned for today.

3. Let the matter be listed on 05.03.2025.
4.
It is made clear that the matter will not be adjourned on the next date as a matter of right."
4. On the last date it was directed that the matter will not be adjourned on the next date as a matter of right.
Today again there is no representation on behalf of the applicant (s).
5. Since there is no representation on behalf of the applicant (s), the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed for want of prosecution.
6. Interim order, if any, stands vacated.

7. Office to communicate this order to trial court concerned within two weeks from today.
8.
Pending application (s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
(Samit Gopal, J.) Order Date :- 5.3.2025 Gaurav Kuls  Babloo Kumar S/O Dauli Ram vs State Of Up Thro Principal Secretary ...
